Welcome to PromptoftheDay.

Here, I'm going to go ahead and reiterate some guidelines for you all before I take us back into v/all! Nothing scary nor evil, I just want to make sure we have a few things down.

The Prompts

  • When Making a prompt or submission, give credit to the artist
  • If you are linking OC, let us know! We love it when our users create awesome things
  • We enjoy a variety of prompts, but please no Sexually explicit images -- If you feel it's Sexually explicit, go ahead and tag it NSFW.
  • want to make a music prompt? Go ahead. See the next section

Music Prompts

We love music, and it drives us to write. But, in order to keep with the spirit of vagueness, I would Like to humbly make some rules (WHICH CAN BE CHANGED --- NO WORRIES)

  • Try to get out of posting things with lyrics so that the writer isn't forced to limit perspective. E.G. "Summertime Sadness" wouldn't be okay, but something like "Fistfull of Dollars Theme" would be.
  • Give credit to the Artist
  • In your title Write [MUSIC PROMPT] Title- Artist

This is a new realm for us, but I feel like it could really help. Please try to keep a balance between Music and image prompts. Remember, we don't want to flood it with Music, just like we don't want ONLY sci-fi prompts or Fantasy prompts

The Culture and a few Protocols.

We're all here to practice writing. We may enjoy it, we may just be trying to get better, we may even need a secondary outlet. But Writing is a weirdly cathartic and emotional experience for many, so keep that in mind when you are reading though.

  • Don't Downvoat. Instead, Comment, help, and mention why you didn't like a story.
  • If someone does go through and downvoats, don't worry. It's not reflective on you as a writer. It may just be the downvoater is a troll, a person who doesn't agree with your overall motif, or anything. Try not to let it get you down.
  • Be respectful. You don't have to say "OH MY GOD I LOVE IT" but be respectful. For every three bad things about a story, mention one good thing.
  • If you write something here, and want some help, check our our sister subverses. There are a bunch of them.

Various Tags

Sometimes I may not get around to "flairing" everything (I have work and a lot of things) so to make things easier here are a few tags:

[MUSIC] - used for music prompts

[NSFW] - if you post a link with gore or possible nudity, go ahead and tag it if it's appropriate.

[META] - You can use this if you have ideas for the subverse. Anything from new types of images, or if you notice too many images or prompts in the same genre you can tell us about it and what you'd like to see.

[INTRODUCTION] - If you want to introduce yourself go ahead and do so! If we have enough I will make another Intro thread!

Challenge Prompts

If it's requested, I will make a prompt with specific guidelines and a theme that you requested. Just PM me with "Challenge Prompt Request" as the title and the nature of the challenge in the body.

If you all have any ideas, go ahead and reply! I am here to listen!
